Ava M: quick sync  final internal release note for 2.21.0 ready. planning internal blast at 17:00 PT. need final pin wording + rollback bullets.
Rory J: dropping draft and will paste model SHAs. canary plan: 4% for 15m -> 20% for 15m -> full.
Docs Claire: PR link: https://phab/repo/PR-5125 (internal note + runbook). trimmed customer-facing lines.
deploy-bot: preflight OK, staging snapshot snap-2026-03-23-1702 created.
oncall-ken: i'll be on standby 16:30-19:00. please include explicit kill-switch and authorized users.
Rory J: added commands in PR:
```
# pin
rbinctl pin --env=prod --model=rdw-stable --hash=badf00d1234
# kill-switch (oncall only)
rbinctl traffic --env=prod --set-canary=0
```
Ava M: rollback shorthand for internal note: ANY of -> 5m error rate >=2% OR P95 token latency +45% OR >=2 failed smoke tests => set canary=0 and notify #eng-oncall. If TWO thresholds met within 10m escalate to SEV. wait 3m after canary=0 to validate metrics. full playbook in PR.
Docs Claire: added grafana dashboard and checklist: token_latency.p95, inference.errors/5m, model_mem.
Rory J: ops needs final copy by 15:30 PT for deploybot. timeline: 15:00 final copy to ops, 15:45 hashes locked, 16:30 oncall confirmed, 17:00 deploy window.
Ava M: one-liner for deploybot: "Deploy 2.21.0 to hosted/dedicated. Canary 4% -> 20% -> full. Rollback rules in internal note." keep short.
oncall-ken: ack, standby and kill-switch ready.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy window 17:00-18:00 PT. quiet-mode set to #eng-oncall.
Rory J: pasted model hashes in the internal note.
Ava M: final checklist done. i'll post internal blast at 17:05 with the one-liner and link to PR. thanks team :rocket:
